content.value: Deduce an expression for the determination of core print length X of a core having diameter (12) D and length L. A hollow steel component of having 20mm inner diameter and 40mm length to be cast. Determine the length of the core print. Given: Steel density 7.8 g/cm³, core density 1.67g/cm³, core compressive strength 2.5 g/cm².
